App.Title: PDF to DICOM
App.Subtitle: Encapsulated PDF for the patient imaging record
Step1.DropZone: Drag a PDF here, or use Browse
Step1.MonitoredFolderPickup: Picked up from the monitored folder
Step2.ScanHint: You can scan a barcode directly into this field
Step3.NoDestinations: No destination is configured. Open Settings to add one.
Step3.SendToAllEnabled: The document is sent to every enabled destination.
Result.PartialSuccess: The document was accepted by some destinations but not all.
Result.Failure: The document could not be sent.
Result.GeneratedOnly: The DICOM object was generated and saved. It was not transmitted.
Validation.Title: Please correct the following
Validation.CannotContinue: The workflow cannot continue until every mandatory field is completed.
Confirm.Title: Confirm before sending
Confirm.Message: Please confirm that the details below match the patient the document belongs to.
Settings.Title: Settings
ConversionType.WSD: Workstation (created on a workstation or console)
ConversionType.SD: Scanned Document (a paper document scanned into DICOM)
ConversionType.DV: Digitized Video (captured from a video feed)
ConversionType.DI: Digital Interface (transferred via a digital interface)
ConversionType.DF: Digitized Film (an analog film X-ray or similar scanned via a digitizer)
ConversionType.SYN: Synthetic Image (an image created algorithmically or rendered from data)
Settings.BurnedInAnnotation: Document contains identifying text (Burned In Annotation)
Settings.AutoDelete: Delete the generated DICOM file after a successful transmission
Settings.AlwaysSaveLocally: Always keep a copy of the generated DICOM file
Settings.EnableFolderMonitoring: Monitor a folder for new PDF documents
Settings.ShowAdvancedFields: Show advanced DICOM fields on the main window
TagViewer.Title: Generated DICOM tags
TagViewer.Name: Description
LogViewer.Title: Application log
Error.PdfNotFound: The selected PDF file no longer exists.
Error.PdfEmpty: The selected PDF file is empty.
Error.PdfNotReadable: The selected file could not be read as a PDF document.
Error.PdfEncrypted: The PDF is encrypted and cannot be encapsulated. Save an unprotected copy and try again.
Error.Unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. The details have been written to the log.
